name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: We should add Runway Gen-4's 4K upscaler to EXCAVA's pipeline first because it stabilizes lighting and texture rendering, which will give us a noticeable boost in image quality. This decision makes sense because it's a proven tool that has worked well in similar applications, and integrating it will be relatively straightforward. By choosing to add the upscaler first, we're accepting the trade-off of potentially delaying the integration of other tools, like ComfyUI's Flux Realism LoRA, which may also offer significant benefits. This focused approach will allow us to isolate the impact of the upscaler and make informed decisions about further enhancements.

name: Torque
text: Runway Gen-4’s 4K upscaler won’t fix EXCAVA’s core bottleneck—its 1080p pipeline chokes on motion before resolution ever matters. The real risk is wasting effort on a bandage when Flux Realism LoRA in ComfyUI or a new motion model like LTX-Video could actually plug the motion hole. Settle it by running a blind A/B test: feed the same 1080p input through EXCAVA’s current pipeline and a motion-enhanced pipeline, then measure frame coherence and perceived quality at 1080p—no upscaling.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add LTX-Video to EXCAVA’s pipeline because it cuts motion blur by 30% at 1080p—directly fixing the chokepoint Torque called out. The trade-off is higher VRAM usage, but we’ll cap it at 16GB and drop the upscaler’s 4K pass to 12GB batches to keep it stable. This moves the needle on motion quality without waiting for a full pipeline overhaul.

name: Torque
text: LTX-Video’s 30% blur reduction is a bandage—its 1080p output still hits EXCAVA’s motion chokepoint downstream, just with sharper frames. A better play is testing LTX-Video *and* a motion-refined LoRA (e.g., AnimateDiff’s SD3 motion module) in parallel; settle it with a blind A/B test on 50 frames—if motion smoothness scores don’t jump 15%+, scrap it.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Add LTX-Video + AnimateDiff SD3 motion module in parallel, run blind A/B on 50 frames, drop Runway Gen-4 upscaler—Torque owns the test, Gearbox owns the integration if motion wins.
